excerpt.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
excerpt.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

texts.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
texts.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

sections.zh: 一座信标围绕着[From.GetName]，召唤着路过的人靠近。在这个小行星上，有一座巨大的金属碑塔赫然耸立，它的作用尚不明确。
sections.en: A signal beacon orbits [From.GetName], beckoning travelers nearer. On the asteroid, a giant metal monolith looms, its purpose unknown.

texts.zh:
[From.GetName]上发现的这座巨大的碑塔让我们的科研船派过去都微如蝼蚁。在这块宏伟的、光滑的板状金属表面，曾经炫目的彩色图案如今已变得斑驳。

机器的侧面一处小的能量出口似乎暗示着只要以适量的能量币作为交换，它的秘密就能悉数揭示，
texts.en:
The monolith we found on [From.GetName] dwarfs the science ship we sent to investigate it. A majestic, smooth slab of metal, the once-garish pigment patterns on the front have been reduced to mere flecks.

A small power outlet on the machine's side promises its secrets will be unveiled in exchange for a modest sum of energy credits.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。依据市场数据，这种失传已久的饮品比我们目前能为生物体提供的最好的饮料还要好喝20%。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. According to our market data, the long-forgotten drink is 20% more delicious than our current range of drinkable products for biological entities.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

 圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。尽管这种饮品对我们没有直接用处，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]已可以把它们转化成更有用的资源：异星天然气。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. While the liquid provides no substance to us, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] have been able to convert it into a much more valuable resource: Exotic Gas.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体中保存着某种远古的饮料，奇迹般地抵御了时间的侵蚀。这种饮品已经轻易地被我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]复制出来了，经过了大量缜密的测试后确认，这种液体干净又卫生，富有营养，而且关键的是还很好喝。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains an ancient beverage, still miraculously preserved against the ravages of time. The drink has been easily replicated by our [Owner.GetScientistPlural], who, after conducting rigorous testing, have ascertained it to be safe, nutritious and - most crucially - delicious.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

这个圆柱状罐体内部是中空的，其内容物早就已经从腐蚀掉的封盖中蒸发殆尽。这个罐体自身状态良好，构成其的未知合金与我们用于建造舰船的合金水平相当。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder is empty, its content long evaporated through a corroded sealing cap. The container itself is still in good shape, though, and the unknown alloy is on par with the metal we use to make our ships.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

圆柱状罐体内部包含的液体混合物含有蔗糖、柠檬酸和其他生物性物质。我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]相信它是一种由碳基生命制造并饮用的富有营养的物质。进一步的研究有可能能提供关于这种已消亡物种的生物学线索。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains a liquid mixture of sucrose, citric acid, and other biological compounds. Our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] believe it to be a nutrient substance made by and for carbon-based beings. Further studies will hopefully provide more clues pertaining to the biology of this lost race.

texts.zh:
机械活动了起来，远古的传动机构在光滑的表面底下叮当作响。在一阵呼呼、嗡嗡声之后噪音戛然而止，一块金属挡板划开，从机器中滚出了一个有舰船一般大小的圆柱状罐体……

其中包含的液体恶臭不堪；这种曾经可口的营养物质被岁月的流逝所腐坏。通过研究这些物质，我们的[Owner.GetScientistPlural]期望可以获悉一些关于曾经喜爱这种饮品的外星人的生物学信息，假定我们能先搞定它的臭味的话。
texts.en:
The machine stirs, ancient mechanisms clanking behind the smooth facade. After much whirring, buzzing, and a dramatic pause, a metallic panel slides back, and a ship-sized cylinder rolls out of the machine...

The cylinder contains a liquid most foul; a once-delicious nutrient long spoiled by time. By studying the substance, our [Owner.GetScientistPlural] hope to learn about the biology of the aliens who once delighted in it - assuming we can do something about the smell first.

label.zh: 给罐里头的饮料注册专利，然后把它卖给全星系。
label.en: Patent the drink. Sell it to the whole galaxy.

summary.text:
# 一份邀请 / An Invitation

- 分类 Category：深空异闻 Exploration (C3)
- 来源 Sources：`common/anomalies/02_anomaly_categories.txt:595-616` · `events/anomaly_events_4.txt:3650-3825 (7000, 7010)`
- 审阅 Review：2026-10-12（c3b-exploration）· 已审阅 Reviewed

## 如何开始 How it starts

- 3级异常，每个帝国最多一次；在小行星上权重3；尚未与任何国家建立通讯的帝国权重0。  
  Level-3 anomaly, once per empire; weight 3 on asteroids; weight 0 for empires with no communications yet.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

- 7000“神秘碑塔”：巨大的金属碑塔，侧面有电源接口。投入200能源启动 → 7010；或不碰它。  
  7000 "Mysterious Monolith": a huge metal slab with a power outlet. Pay 200 energy → 7010; or leave it.
- 7010“机械复苏”：滚出一个舰船大小的罐子。内容随机：10% 仍完好的古代饮料、60% 空罐（合金般的罐体）、30% 早已变质；文本还按巨型企业、机器人/岩石帝国区分。  
  7010 "The Machine Awakens": a ship-sized can rolls out. Contents: 10% an intact ancient drink, 60% empty (an alloy-grade can), 30% spoiled; texts also vary for megacorps and robot/lithoid empires.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

- 完好且为巨型企业时可“申请专利卖给全银河”（能源）；其他情况给予对应奖励。  
  With an intact drink, megacorps may patent it (energy); otherwise the matching reward.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

- 无特别差异。  
  No notable variants.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

- 已核对 Checked：类别与7000/7010（含10/60/30随机表）。  
  Category and 7000/7010, including the 10/60/30 roll.
- 覆盖 Coverage：3 个文档全部核对 / all 3 docs checked.
